name: Altai-Sibir Airlines
blurb: A Siberian low-cost carrier flying across Russia and to neighbouring countries from Novosibirsk and Barnaul.

about: Altasib is a Russian low-cost carrier flying from Novosibirsk, with its original base at Barnaul. It serves destinations across Russia, with international flights to China, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Belarus, Türkiye and Egypt.

The airline was founded in Barnaul in 1992 with a fleet of Tupolev Tu-154s and Tu-134s, and later moved most of its flying to Novosibirsk. Over the years it replaced its Soviet aircraft with Boeing 737-800s and Airbus A320s and A321s.
network: Novosibirsk is the main hub, linking Siberia with Moscow and Saratov, with Anadyr in the far north-east, and with Ankara abroad.

current: 10 aircraft · 8 leased from S7, 2 from Turkish Airlines
